messages:
Olivia: Heads-up — FinCorp sent an updated security questionnaire and scheduled a security review call tomorrow 10:00 PT. Main asks: (1) encryption at rest / KMS envelope flow + key custody proof, (2) audit log retention & delivery, (3) RBAC for cross-team service accounts, (4) CVE mitigation timeline. Need owners & artifacts.
Kevin: I'll own KMS flow and can produce an architecture diagram + sequence of ops. Which evidence do they want? Key provenance or signing certs?
Maria (compliance): They asked for key custody proofs and rotation cadence + KMS policy snippets. Also want a signed manifest showing which keys are customer-managed vs Redwood-managed.
Kevin: For cloud KMS we can export IAM policy and a key metadata snapshot. Example command: ```gcloud kms keys describe projects/PROJECT/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/key --format=json > key-metadata.json``` Can also produce KMS audit events from Cloud Audit Logs for the key usage window.
Sachin: For audit logs, we can provide a 30-day snapshot and a SIEM ingest link. Suggested retention statement: "Audit logs are retained for 90 days in hot storage; 7 years in cold archive (customer option)" — does that match product policy?
Maria (compliance): Yes, that's our standard offer but FinCorp asked for 5 years. We need an exception note for enterprise contract. I'll draft.
Samir (eng): RBAC: recommend a minimal set of service account roles: `redwood:tenant-audit-reader`, `redwood:model-invoker`, and `redwood:billing-reader`. Can we show a sample Terraform snippet for granting tenant-audit-reader scoped to a project?
Olivia: Yes, please add the snippet and a short explanation of least-privilege mapping to typical customer personas (Platform, App, Billing).
Kevin: On HSM vs cloud KMS: FinCorp is asking if we can support customer HSM on-prem. We have a private deployment option; I can outline the HSM integration steps and data flow. Will include HSM attestation guidance (PKCS#11 certs).
Sachin: There's also the open CVE (CVE-2026-1357) flagged in our base image used for Dedicated nodes. Patch queued in next image build (rolling deploy starting tomorrow). For the call we can offer timeline + mitigation (network isolation + backport patch). I can attach the CVE tracker export.
Olivia: Perfect. Who can assemble a single evidence bundle (diagram, key metadata, IAM policies, log snapshot query, RBAC tf snippet, CVE tracker, signed statement) by EOD today?
Kevin: I'll generate key metadata + HSM notes.
Maria (compliance): I'll produce the signed statement + retention exception draft.
Sachin: I'll export logs and CVE tracker. Need a short runbook for log export: ```# export logs example
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_container"' --start="2026-03-01T00:00:00Z" --end="2026-03-10T00:00:00Z" --format=json > audit-snapshot.json```
Olivia: Awesome — thanks. I'll consolidate into a zip and upload to the support secure share. Call invite sent to FinCorp + solution architect. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: Automated snapshot created: /artifacts/finsec/2745001234/logs-snapshot.tar.gz
Kevin: Noted, will reference the artifact in the bundle.
Maria (compliance): One ask — FinCorp wants a sample query showing how to prove a particular API call was made (tenantID X, key usage). I'll add a Kibana/BigQuery example.
Olivia: Great. We're all set. Meeting notes owner: Olivia; followups tracked in #customer-security-inbox. Thanks everyone.
